description:
Immersive chat with friends.

Chat with your friends as usual. Vipi gradually introduces the language you are learning into the messages you read. Selected words and short phrases switch in place between familiar wording and the new language. Your friends do not need to know that language or change how they write.

Start with a few words
Choose how many new words appear. Words you have already seen can appear alongside them. The rest keeps its original wording, word order and grammar. Available vocabulary varies by language; unsupported words stay unchanged. Try the English and Spanish example before signing in.

Read and listen at your own pace
Pause the changes or show the original message at any time. Tap Listen to hear pronunciation. Reading guides can show words in Latin letters. Available guides and voices depend on your languages and downloads.

Keep your conversations private
Connect through usernames and invitations. Chats with friends are end-to-end encrypted. Automatic word switching runs entirely on your device without a translation-model download. Full translation is a separate on-device action and may require a language download. You can save an encrypted history backup to a location you choose.

Talk with vBot
Bot mini is an optional additional plan for chatting with vBot, a chatbot. Messages you send to vBot go to our response provider, and automated replies can be mistaken. You see the monthly reply allowance before subscribing.

Start with 30 days free
Your first 30 days of Vipi are free, without starting a subscription or providing payment details. After that, choose whether to subscribe. There is no automatic charge when the free period ends. In the US, Vipi is $12 per year. Bot mini is a separate optional $48-per-year subscription and requires active Vipi access. Bot mini offers its own one-month free trial for eligible subscribers. Your store shows the local price and renewal date before purchase. Subscriptions you choose renew automatically unless canceled through your store. You can still read and export your existing local history after access ends.
